text: Accuracy of the skinfold technique is highly dependent on the skill of the practitioner. Its biggest potential downside is a lack of testing competency, leading to technical measurement error. Proper training and many hours of practice on a wide variety of individuals are necessary for becoming proficient in the technique. The quality of the calipers is another possible source of error in skinfold analysis. Calipers can differ in dial accuracy, surface area of the jaw faces, and force or pressure exerted at the jaw faces (76), and these differences can have a profound impact on results (16).
